findings.title: tool_choice none acceptance unverified
findings.problem: Required criterion AC5 is partial: the guard sets tool_choice none alongside the placeholder tool, but acceptance of that by the gateway and Bedrock, and the text-block compaction reply, are not evidenced.
findings.impact: If the gateway or Bedrock rejects tool_choice none on a compaction-shaped request, the original EPMCDME-16965 failure persists or changes form.
findings.recommendation: Provide captured request/response or gateway evidence that tool_choice none is accepted; otherwise set SET_TOOL_CHOICE_NONE to false (description-only fallback).
findings.check_notes: Evidence-kind finding: fix_evidence has only a decision record, no artifact or exit-0 command. Source shows SET_TOOL_CHOICE_NONE=false, but source cannot resolve an evidence finding; supply artifact/command evidence or re-classify.

findings.recommendation: Treat null like undefined: if (body.tool_choice === undefined || body.tool_choice === null).
